items.quote: We will not support the appointment of an auditor if the fees paid to the auditor for non-audit services exceed 50 percent of the total fees paid in two consecutive years.
items.why: The rule is not triggered. Non-audit fees (audit-related, tax and other) were about 2.3 million of 17.9 million in 2024 and about 1.6 million of 18.1 million in 2025, far below 50 percent.
